scope: Local visual-only 15-route New England pack, Daytona noon boundary repair, dedicated Sebring ground palette, QA tooling/evidence. No remote mutations, world lighting/weather/time/geometry/physics/scenery/mission/car changes, deletion or cleanup.

units.initialFindings: Initial run overlapped Sebring binding and saw an unplaced new texture; also correctly caught stale main-route placement registry. Final stable run passed after explicit tower/mount placement migration, with no assertion changes or exemptions.

native.manual: Viewed all desktop/handheld exposure and two pitch/wrap contact sheets, plus source art. Native rendering success is not seam or gameplay acceptance.

qa.visibleWarning: UNUSED CONFIGURED ART: road-snow-patchy — Pikes Peak Highway snow mapping has no active segment; retained configuration debt.

manualPriority: Hurricane Mountain and Loudon have conspicuous desktop wrap landform/tree-height jumps.
Other new skies retain visible safe-band transitions or small wrap/color joins; numeric non-warning is not visual approval.
Mount Washington authored native visibility opacity 1 hides the sky completely. Pinkham opacity .7263 washes it out. No exposure/weather change made.
Tower Hill authored .05 exposure makes the sky nearly black. Actual night headlights/snow were viewed together; separate sky100 diagnostic shows cloudy snowy woods, no moon or daylight panorama.

Tower Hill desktop reached real driving and moved, then final-speed assertion received -0.070110999 after straight test input left the opening bend. Do not count as a passed drive or infer a baseline cause.
visualIssues.nightComparisonMethod: Tower Hill handheld authored and sky100 frames are consecutive moving frames with unchanged world lighting/weather, not a frozen pixel-matched pose. Native sky-only diagnostic pairs use exact matched yaw/viewport.

daytona.baselineOutcome: One desktop comparison passed, real movement, no missing art/network/page errors. Prior pack5 candidate failure is not established as baseline; no baseline retry.
daytona.boundaryReview: Former strong bottom grass/water clamp streaks reduced; low-contrast band variation remains under extreme pitch. Not claimed seamless.
daytona.currentOutcome: Revised candidate desktop passed, actual grandstand horizon visible, no missing-art/page/network errors. This and the one baseline pass do not establish the cause of the prior pack5 startup failure.
daytona.remainingVisual: Foreground remains the previously bound shared green grass; broader palette/route-wide acceptance still pending. Noon bottom clamp variation is reduced, not eliminated.

sebring.scope: Dedicated muted olive sandy grass for three layout image bindings, physical snow IDs/weights unchanged. Prior PNGs and shared grass asset retained.
sebring.productionReview: Viewed retained desktop and handheld actual authored frames against prior pack5 frames. Saturated green foreground changed to muted olive/sandy grass and joins the panorama more naturally. Both current driving samples passed. Views are comparable, not pixel-matched poses; original props/lighting unchanged.

before.method: df available bytes and du -s allocated KiB, not apparent bytes. Shared Git object store counted once; totals overlap and are not additive. No cleanup.

after.note: Allocated du values, overlapping paths/shared objects are NOT additive. df available is practical overlay headroom. No cleanup/deletion performed.

disk.forecast: Rough extrapolation of current measured pack growth, including retained source images, Git objects and compact QA; remaining bindings alone may consume about 2.3 GB. Further driving/revisions can add more. No cleanup or deletion performed.
